summary: Added optional due date: core.parse_date (strict regex + fromisoformat), Task.due NotRequired, add_task(due=), overdue_tasks(today); cli add --due, list --overdue, format_task suffix, today() reading TASKLIST_TODAY. README documents it. Old files untouched: due key only written when given.
assumptions: cmd_add tells a bad due from a blank title by checking args.title.strip(), so the title error wins when both are bad.
In cmd_list, any ValueError from overdue_tasks path is reported as invalid TASKLIST_TODAY; a malformed stored due would be misreported (spec says not handled).
